newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNB sells realty arm for 505.62 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: PNB sells realty arm for 505.62 mln pesos.

text.p: Philippine National Bank said on Monday it has sold its entire holding in its real estate unit, PNB Management and Development Corp, to a local group for 505.62 million pesos.

"We are pleased to inform you that the PNB has consummated today the sale of its entire stockholdings in one of its subsidiaries, the PNB Management and Development Corp to Mega-Prime Realty and Holdings Corp," executive vice president Valentin Araneta told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
The unit was involved in the construction of PNB branches.
